{{Short description|Irish supermarket chain}} {{For|companies of the same name in other countries|SuperValu (disambiguation){{!}}SuperValu}} {{Infobox company | name = SuperValu | logo = SuperValuLogo.svg | logo_caption = | image = Main Street looking towards Pennyhill Hacketstown Carlow 2011 (cropped).JPG | image_caption = SuperValu [[Hacketstown]] | type = [[Subsidiary]] | industry = [[Retail industry|Retail]] | founded = {{start date and age|1968|6|27|df=y}} in [[Douglas, Cork]] | predecessor = VG (Voluntary Group){{cite web |title=Musgrave Group Plc {{!}} Encyclopedia.com |url=https://www.encyclopedia.com/books/politics-and-business-magazines/musgrave-group-plc |website=www.encyclopedia.com}} | hq_location_city = [[Cork (city)|Cork]] | hq_location_country = Ireland | num_locations = 258https://www.irishtimes.com/business/2025/11/20/supervalu-owner-musgrave-made-26m-weekly-profit-in-year-of-record-sales | num_locations_year = 2025 | areas_served = [[Republic of Ireland]]
[[Northern Ireland]]
[[Spain]] | key_people = Luke Hanlon (managing director){{cite news | title=Luke Hanlon appointed managing director of SuperValu and Centra | newspaper=[[The Irish Times]] | url=https://www.irishtimes.com/business/2024/08/19/luke-hanlon-appointed-managing-director-of-supervalu-and-centra/ }} | products = | brands = | revenue = [[Euro|€]]2.58 billion (2014){{cite web|url=http://www.rte.ie/news/business/2015/0413/693800-supervalu-overtakes-tesco-as-top-grocery-retailer/|title=SuperValu overtakes Tesco as top grocery retailer|date=13 April 2015|work=RTÉ News|accessdate=2019-10-25|url-status=live|archive-date=2019-06-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190619202448/https://www.rte.ie/news/business/2015/0413/693800-supervalu-overtakes-tesco-as-top-grocery-retailer/}} | owner = | num_employees = 14,500 | num_employees_year = 2015 | parent = [[Musgrave Group]] | website = {{URL|supervalu.ie|SuperValu.ie}} | footnotes = | bodystyle = }} '''SuperValu''' is a [[supermarket]] chain that operates throughout the island of [[Ireland]]. SuperValu is operated as a [[symbol group]]; each supermarket is independently owned, with individual owners using the SuperValu format and selling the chain's [[own brand]] products. SuperValu outlets tend to be larger than the [[convenience shop]] formats used by many other symbol group retailers such as [[Centra]], [[Gala (supermarket)|Gala]] and [[SPAR (retailer)|Spar]], and the larger SuperValu units are on a par with full-service supermarkets. Their main competitors are [[Dunnes Stores]] and [[Tesco Ireland|Tesco]]. ==History== [[File:SuperValu (Kavanagh's), The Glebe, Donegal Town - geograph.org.uk - 4670789.jpg|thumb|SuperValu, The Glebe, Donegal Town]] The supermarket was founded on {{Start date|1968|6|27|df=y}} out of the larger outlets in [[Musgrave Group|Musgrave]]'s VG chain (originally formed in 1960).{{Cite web|url=http://www.solocheck.ie/Irish-Company/Super-Valu-Douglas-Limited-26790|title=Super Valu Douglas Limited - Irish Company Info - SoloCheck|website=www.solocheck.ie|language=en|access-date=2017-06-04|archive-date=2021-09-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210924160544/https://www.solocheck.ie/Irish-Company/Super-Valu-Douglas-Limited-26790|url-status=live}} The smaller VG shops became [[Centra]]. From a base of sixteen supermarkets (mainly in [[Munster]]), SuperValu had 182 shops in the [[Republic of Ireland]] and 36 in [[Northern Ireland]] as of 2004. Along the way, Musgrave has pursued a policy of buying shops itself and then re-leasing them to franchisees, acquiring some of the insolvent [[H Williams (supermarket)|H Williams]] shops in 1987, L&N in 1995, and Wellworths (in Northern Ireland) in 1996. Wellworths-SuperValu was a trading name used briefly by Musgrave in Northern Ireland following its acquisition of small-to-medium [[Wellworths]] outlets in 1996. This was to distinguish from larger Wellworths supermarkets which were acquired by [[Safeway Stores (Ireland)]], a joint venture between [[Fitzwilton]] and [[Safeway (UK)]]. In due course, the Wellworths name was entirely dropped. SuperValu previously operated supermarkets in larger [[Roches Stores]] locations under the name "SuperValu at Roches Stores" for many years. [[Superquinn]] was bought by the [[Musgrave Group]], parent of SuperValu, in 2011.{{Cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-14201675|title=Musgrave group buys Superquinn|date=2011-07-19|work=BBC News|access-date=2020-01-21|language=en-GB|archive-date=2021-09-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210924160545/https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-14201675|url-status=live}} In August 2013, it was announced that all Superquinn supermarkets would be rebranded to SuperValu. The rebranding was completed in February 2014.{{cite news |title=Superquinn stores rebranded as SuperValu today |url=http://www.rte.ie/news/business/2014/0213/504035-superquinn-supervalu-rebrand/ |access-date=2019-10-25 |url-status=live |work=RTÉ News |date=13 Feb 2014 |archive-date=2014-08-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140819082634/http://www.rte.ie/news/business/2014/0213/504035-superquinn-supervalu-rebrand/ }} As a result, SuperValu became the second-largest supermarket chain in the [[Republic of Ireland]] by grocery spend.{{cite web | url=https://www.kantarworldpanel.com/global/News/Superquinn-rebrand-makes-SuperValu-Irelands-2nd-supermarket | title=Superquinn rebrand makes SuperValu Ireland's 2nd retailer - Global site - Kantar Worldpanel }} SuperValu's stores in Spain are branded as Dialprix, Musgrave's Spanish business. Due to this, the SuperValu brand name no longer exists in Spain.{{fact|date=January 2025}} ==See also== *[[Centra]] *[[Gala (supermarket)|Gala]] *[[Spar (retailer)|Spar]] *[[Superquinn]] *[[Musgrave Group]] *[[List of Irish companies]] == References == ==External links== *[http://www.supervalu.ie/ SuperValu.ie] {{Supermarkets in Ireland}} [[Category:Supermarkets of the Republic of Ireland]] [[Category:Supermarkets of Northern Ireland]] [[Category:Supermarkets of Spain]] [[Category:Irish brands]] [[Category:1968 establishments in Ireland]] [[Category:Retail companies established in 1968]]
